metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Washington D.C. for 2018, specifically if it was at least 50 inches. I need to: 1. Strategy: Use precipitation data. CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) is a good global precipitation dataset. 2. Location: Washington D.C. - I'll use a point geometry around the city center. 3. Time: Year 2018 4. Processing: Sum daily precipitation to get annual total, then convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) Data quality checks: - First check if collection has data - Then check if we get valid pixel counts - Validate the result isn't None/NaN CHIRPS dataset: 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' - provides daily precipitation in mm ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions dc_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]) start_date = '2018-01-01' end_date = '2018-12-31' # 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \ .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \ .filterBounds(dc_point) # Check if collection is empty if precip_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No precipitation data found for 2018") print("C1") else: # Sum all daily precipitation to get annual total (in mm) annual_precip = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum() # Check valid pixels pixel_count = annual_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=dc_point.buffer(5000), # 5km buffer around DC scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() if pixel_count == 0: print("No valid precipitation pixels") print("C2") else: # Get annual precipitation in mm, convert to inches precip_mm = annual_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=dc_point.buffer(5000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo() # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm) precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4 if precip_mm is not None else None # Validation if precip_inches is None or precip_inches < 0 or precip_inches > 200: print(f"Invalid precipitation value: {precip_inches}") print("C3") else: print(f"2018 Annual Precipitation: {precip_inches:.1f} inches") print(f"Valid Pixels: {pixel_count}") if precip_inches >= 50: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
dc_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072])
start_date = '2018-01-01'
end_date = '2018-12-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data
precip_col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
    .filterBounds(dc_point)

# Check if collection is empty
if precip_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No precipitation data found for 2018")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Sum all daily precipitation to get annual total (in mm)
    annual_precip = precip_col.select('precipitation').sum()
    
    # Check valid pixels
    pixel_count = annual_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=dc_point.buffer(5000),  # 5km buffer around DC
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid precipitation pixels")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Get annual precipitation in mm, convert to inches
        precip_mm = annual_precip.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=dc_point.buffer(5000),
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # Convert mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm)
        precip_inches = precip_mm / 25.4 if precip_mm is not None else None
        
        # Validation
        if precip_inches is None or precip_inches < 0 or precip_inches > 200:
            print(f"Invalid precipitation value: {precip_inches}")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"2018 Annual Precipitation: {precip_inches:.1f} inches")
            print(f"Valid Pixels: {pixel_count}")
            
            if precip_inches >= 50:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
